title: Scaled Dot-Product Attention
alt: Single-head attention: independent Q and K branches form scaled scores, softmax produces probabilities, and a separate V branch joins the final matrix product.
strengths: Distinct operand branches and correct dimensions.
A wide single reading path and restrained coral/sage accents.
No extra hardware or invented traffic.
limitations: Symbolic tensor grids are illustrative, not literal element counts.
Row-wise normalization is documented in input but not explicitly printed in the final figure.

provenance.workflow: silicon_prepare → host semantic spec → silicon_compile → built-in image_gen

description: An elegant paper-quality dataflow figure for single-head scaled dot-product attention. Inputs Q [N,d], K [M,d], V [M,dv]. K passes through transpose, Q and K^T meet in matrix multiplication S=QK^T / sqrt(d), followed by row-wise Softmax P=softmax(S), then P and V meet in O=PV producing O [N,dv]. Show Q and K as separate branches, and V as a distinct bypass branch feeding the last multiply. No causal mask, multihead, hardware or memory traffic; only this single-head mathematical operation. English labels, clear tensor shapes, compact landscape figure suitable for a research presentation. The main path and independent V branch should be readable immediately.

settings.notes: Editorial research figure aesthetic: warm white canvas, charcoal hairline outlines, dusty indigo for Q and K, muted coral for scores/normalization, sage for values and output. Matrix tensors as crisp small 2D gridded rectangles; operation nodes concise white circles or compact rounded rectangles. Dominant straight left-to-right path with generous spacing; V uses one clean parallel top bypass, no gratuitous bends, no shadows, no 3D, no gradients, no giant title. Equations are the hierarchy, not decorative boxes. Produce a refined wide paper figure rather than a busy slide.
